programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Jhon Fredy y Miguel Ángel adoptaron una niña, pero el Colegio Americano de Bogotá los rechazó por ser una familia homoparental. Fabio Meneses y Xiomy Díaz sufrieron en terapias de conversión. Andrés Felipe Arboleda fue asesinado por discriminación en Caldas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En 2018, Yeimy Ilias aceptó la propuesta de ser la señora fotogénica después de que a su hija le hicieron la oferta de ser niña Barranquilla.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Casos de negligencia y posibles abusos bajo el cuidado del ICBF exponen un sistema en crisis: muertes sin esclarecer, custodias fallidas y maltrato en hogares infantiles plantean graves dudas sobre la protección real de la infancia en Colombia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: El miedo a las represalias ha impedido que las víctimas denuncien delitos en Colombia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Chinchiná, Caldas, en 2012, Angie, de 14 años, desapareció tras aceptar en secreto una cita con un hombre que le prometió un celular. Ocho días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en la vereda "La Pola". La verdad salió a la luz cuando Javier, un preso en Popayán, acusó a su propio hermano del asesinato de la menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En La Montañita, Caquetá, Jhon Jairo Marín rehace su vida con Yineth Mosquera, quien, celosa del hijo de su pareja, Esneider, termina atentando contra la vida del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Rubén Andrade desapareció el 12 de abril de 2020 en Bosa. Su cuerpo fue hallado 4 días después en Soacha. Su ex, Yendi Paola, confesó haberlo envenenado y apuñalado, luego arrojó el cuerpo al río con ayuda de un taxista.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Arauca se conmociono con el triple homicidio cometido al parecer por Jairo Enrique Vargas Maldonado, de 44 años de edad, Secretario de un juzgado de Arauca, acusado de asesinar a su esposa y sus dos hijos de 6 y 14 años de edad.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2007, María Cecilia Viva Salas desapareció en Buenaventura, generando conmoción en su barrio. Inicialmente se sospechó de pandilleros, pero la investigación reveló que su esposo Harvey era el responsable. Su hija Pilar, testigo silenciada por miedo, finalmente reveló pistas clave. El rastreo del celular llevó a su cuerpo, hallado en su propia casa. Harvey confesó y fue condenado a 18 años, aunque salió libre tras cumplir la mitad de la pena.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Entre 1999 y 2003, Manuel Octavio Bermúdez, “el monstruo de los cañaduzales”, asesinó a 18 niños en el Valle del Cauca. Fue capturado tras el testimonio de un sobreviviente y condenado en 2004 a 25 años de prisión por abuso y homicidio serial.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Barbara demanda al club de striptease de Emilio por 30.000 dólares, alegando negligencia y angustia emocional. Ella afirma haber sufrido un latigazo cervical por la actuación de Jackson y una silla que se derrumbó. Emilio niega su responsabilidad, citando la seguridad y el consumo de alcohol de Bárbara.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Elena Sada, sobreviviente de los Legionarios de Cristo, revela en 'Los Informantes' el abuso sistemático del padre Marcial Maciel, quien victimizó a decenas de niños. Durante 20 años, Sada vivió privada de libertad dentro de la secta, incluso reclutando nuevos miembros, hasta escapar y reconstruir su vida. Hoy narra su testimonio en el libro 'El ave negra', exponiendo décadas de encubrimiento eclesiástico.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: El 26 de junio de 2021, Colombia registró su día más letal por COVID-19 con 754 muertes. El periodista Eduardo Contreras investiga a líderes antivacunas como Raúl Salazar, médico que casi murió por el virus pero promueve tratamientos no probados, y Esteban Ramírez, líder del movimiento "Familia por la Verdad". Sus contradicciones reflejan el peligroso abismo entre la desinformación y la ciencia.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Sandra, de 19 años, viaja a Europa engañada. Es secuestrada y explotada. Escapa con ingenio y contacta a su padre. La policía la rescata y regresa a Colombia con su familia.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: La familia de Deshan duda de que Joshua Jr. sea suyo y exigen prueba de paternidad. Melissa, 24, tuvo un bebé con Rob, 47, pero la hija de él pide ADN. ¡Todo se revela hoy en MAURY!

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Danica, una nueva mamá, recibió 5 correos electrónicos diferentes de 5 mujeres asegurando que se acostaron con su novio, Jimmy, en su casa. Entonces, ¿el novio de Renee preferirá su adicción a su familia?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Megan quería saber si su novio Devin era infiel. ¡Pero salieron a la luz secretos de relaciones aún peores! Además, te sorprenderá saber por qué Laura y Steven necesitan que Steve los ayude otra vez.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Pam perdió dos embarazos por el estrés de las acusaciones de infidelidad de Miguel. Felisha admite engañar a Natron, pero él niega ser padre de sus dos hijos. ¡Hoy la verdad saldrá a la luz y cambiará sus vidas!

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Katrina cree que el novio de su hermana Kendra es un infiel y que tiene sexo con su mejor amiga, Nay-Nay. Después, John vuelve al escenario con algo sorprendente.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Jaycee le demuestra a Brandy que nunca es correcto ser infiel y arruinar a una familia. Casi cree que su prometido podría aprender una lección de Kevin, un antiguo invitado. Además, concertamos una cita entre la espectadora Tamara y el invitado Nathan.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Paige quiere que su hombre se comprometa; Mónica sospecha que el novio de su hija la engaña; Ashleigh quiere que dos mujeres muestren sus talentos ocultos para ganar su amor.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Destiny confiesa una aventura; Kashe admite acostarse con la novia de su primo y estalla pelea; dos hombres compiten en un concurso de comida para conquistar a Amber.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Tres mejores amigos acuerdan tener un trío; la prometida de Leo confronta a su primo por unas fotos explícitas que le envió; Brian quiere dejar a su posesiva novia, pero ella se niega a rendirse sin luchar.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Alex afirma que lo forzaron a estar con su novia y guarda un secreto; dos mujeres pelean en puré de manzana por Lexi; Tai dejó Atlanta por Ohio para estar con la mamá de su bebé, pero tiene una confesión.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Josh dice que su mundo se arruinó cuando su novia dio a luz a su hijo, por lo que se acostó con su hermana; Derrick quiere dejar a su novio para poder ser soltero, libre y capaz de hacer sus propias cosas.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Greg le contará a su novia, Deidra, que trabaja en secreto como prostituto gay. El novio de Madrina sigue siendo infiel a ella con su ex. Después, Ro-Ro tiene dos novias y hoy la obligarán a elegir a una de ellas.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Misty odia tanto al marido que se acaba de casar con su mejor amiga que está dispuesta a pagar el divorcio. ¡Lucus está dispuesto a divorciarse de su esposa de 6 semanas si su familia no deja de entrometerse!

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Un hombre transgénero tiene dudas sobre casarse con una mujer; Germaine quiere que su ex lo acepte de nuevo y revela un secreto; el marido de Stormie le da un ultimátum.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Carl ha venido a decirle a su novia que se ha estado acostando con su peor enemiga, Keisha. A continuación, Donte le dirá a su mejor amigo, Quincy, que está acostándose con su prometida. Después, Janel y Nikkie están peleando por el mismo hombre.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, los feminicidios aumentan alarmantemente. Leidy Johana Hernández, víctima de su pareja Nelson Arturo, sufrió años de abuso. A pesar de las advertencias de sus padres, Leidy no escapó. Su cuerpo fue hallado en su casa. La historia revela la urgencia de intervención y denuncia para prevenir tragedias.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En el hospital El Salvador de Ubaté, muertes de bebés por negligencia médica se acumulan entre 2022 y 2023. Padres denuncian diagnósticos erróneos y falta de insumos. La Gerente, ya señalada en un caso anterior, es el blanco de las acusaciones.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Miles de familias colombianas buscan tener casa propia, pero muchas son engañadas. En San Gil, José Luis Sierra y otros invirtieron en un proyecto de vivienda que resultó ser una estafa. En Flandes, Freddy Hernández y su esposa Edna también fueron víctimas de un proyecto sin permisos. Las autoridades investigan.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Una joven llena de sueños cae desde un séptimo piso en circunstancias extrañas. Una relación rota, secretos oscuros y una noche fatídica se entrelazan, mientras una familia busca respuestas y la verdad parece cada vez más elusiva.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En un país donde las motos son el corazón del transporte rural, tragedias silenciosas desgarran familias enteras. Cifras alarmantes reflejan la necesidad urgente de conciencia y firmeza en normas de tránsito.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, las muertes por accidentes viales por exceso de velocidad y embriaguez, siguen creciendo. A pesar de las tragedias, muchos conductores iresponsables quedan impunes, las leyes no logran frenar la creciente cifra de víctimas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Yiset Silva y Lisandro Rodríguez enfrentan un misterio tras el parto de su hija el 31 de diciembre de 2020 en Armenia. La clínica dice que la bebé nació sin vida, pero la familia cree que está viva. Inconsistencias en la historia clínica y una necropsia sin órganos aumentan sus dudas. La Fiscalía investiga.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, varios casos de muertes neonatales han revelado graves negligencias médicas. Las familias afectadas buscan justicia. La falta de leyes que protejan a las madres ha llevado a impulsar una legislación para prevenir la tragedia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Calarcá, Quindío, las primas Luz Enith y Jenny Andrea Morales fueron halladas estranguladas en 2016. La investigación reveló que Jenny mantenía una relación con su ex esposo, Fabián Rendón, quien motivado por celos y venganza planeó el doble feminicidio junto a su cómplice Sebastián Muriel, administrador de un hotel local. Fabián confesó el crimen y señaló a Muriel como coautor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Catalina Díaz Ballesteros contactó a John Alberto Arango Ruiz, un falso astrólogo, buscando ayuda. Junto a su cómplice Javier Andrés Narváez, la drogaron, secuestraron y asesinaron por ambición. Su cuerpo fue hallado en un ataúd artesanal en Bogotá a finales de 2013. Gracias a testigos y una investigación exhaustiva, ambos fueron capturados. Uno confesó y delató al otro, quien enfrenta cargos de secuestro extorsivo, hurto y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Silene Acuña, embarazada, fue hallada muerta bajo el piso de su casa en Mosquera en abril de 2010. Su pareja, Luis Giovanni Mosquera, confesó el crimen tras huir y fue condenado a 21 años. Su hijo, testigo clave, reveló el asesinato en entrevista.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 23 de junio de 2014 en Chinchiná, Alfair Sabogal atacó brutalmente a seis miembros de una familia por celos e intentó matar a su pareja, Diana Marín, quien quedó con secuelas visuales.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Desde los 12 años, una niña fue abusada por un pariente que luego se convirtió en su asesino. Jorge Alonso, tras evadir a la policía por 7 años y cambiar de identidad, fue capturado y espera juicio en Bucaramanga.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2016, en la Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, dos hermanos desaparecieron cerca de la vereda Nuevo Mundo. Tras sospechar inicialmente de la madre, la investigación reveló que David Barbosa Arrieta, empleado de confianza del padre, había abusado y asesinado a los menores. Las pruebas recopiladas confirmaron su culpabilidad, y Barbosa fue condenado a 60 años de prisión.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Ariana García, de 19 años, está demandando a sus padres por angustia emocional y abuso, alegando que la negativa de sus padres a reconocer y respetar su privacidad y sus límites emocionales la ha llevado a perder amigos, confianza y negocios lucrativos como influencer de viajes.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Omar Carmona, quien preparó el cadáver de Escobar, revela detalles de su muerte y las amenazas recibidas. Tras 27 años, la tumba de Escobar sigue siendo un lugar de peregrinación.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Michell, de 13 años, tuvo gemelos prematuros tras huir de Venezuela a Colombia. Sin recursos y con apoyo solo de su madre, lucha por la salud de sus bebés en hospitales de Cúcuta mientras enfrenta rechazo familiar. Su historia refleja la devastadora realidad del embarazo infantil en Latinoamérica, donde miles de niñas enfrentan riesgos de salud, pobreza y abandono cada año.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Gustavo Quintana, "el doctor muerte," falleció tras realizar más de 500 eutanasias a pacientes terminales que buscaban una muerte digna. Yolanda Chaparro, diagnosticada con ELA, luchó un año contra el sistema de salud para lograr su derecho a morir en paz. Horas antes de su eutanasia, Yolanda recibió una serenata de su familia, sonriendo pese a las circunstancias.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: ¿El prometido de Tiffany, Deon, dejó embarazada a su mejor amiga lesbiana? Después, William cree que sus 2 de sus 6 hijos con su ex-esposa Nicole no son suyos y puede ser el padre del hijo de otra mujer! ¡Nuestras pruebas de ADN nos revelan la verdad!

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: ¿Podría La'Nell ser la abuela del bebé de su cuñada Savanna si se acostó con su hijo adolescente, James? Además, Sholonda le dijo a su esposo que quizá no fuera el padre de su hija, pero tras 17 pruebas de ADN, ¡hoy han vuelto!

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Hace un año, Jessica confesó haber sacudido violentamente a su bebé y haberle causado graves lesiones cerebrales. Pero ahora se ha retractado y afirma que un vaso con boquilla le causó las lesiones. ¡Sintoniza la transmisión para saber la verdad!

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Marlon dice haber visto a Bernard abusar de su sobrino, pero Bernard y su hermana lo niegan. Luego, Tarone acusa a Donald de abusar de su hija; Donald alega que la confundió con su tía Felitha.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Cuando la gente normal necesita ayuda, Steve Wilkos está listo para responder a la llamada. Mira cómo Steve ayuda a la gente normal a defenderse y a luchar por sus creencias para promover la justicia para todos.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Un hombre quiere volver con su ex novia; una mujer busca terminar dos relaciones; un hombre intenta salvar su matrimonio.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: El marido de Darleen dice que es adicto a los clubes de striptease; el novio de Mary está obsesionado con limpiar su coche, y ella sospecha que lo está usando como tapadera para algo más; el miedo de Jesse al compromiso lo mete en problemas.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: El novio de Priscilla la engaña y la culpa a ella y a su embarazo; Santana promete cambiar, pero quizá sea tarde; Scoota busca beneficios de pareja sin compromiso.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: La amiga de Ariana quiere que deje a su novio por él; Samantha se declara en huelga porque teme que su novio la engañe.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: La hermana de Megan sabe algo que podría hacerle cambiar de opinión sobre su novio infiel; la Princesa admite tener sentimientos por su ex; la novia de Brad se pregunta por qué ha cambiado su actitud hacia ella.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Shianne confiesa que fue infiel a Mistress Delicious con su mamá Blonde. Después, la madre del bebé de Chris se enfrenta a él por dejarla por su compañera de trío.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Chloe y Dan se casarán pronto, pero finalmente está lista para contarle a él en qué trabaja de verdad. Entonces la madre de Amanda le ruega que renuncie a su trabajo.

programme.title: Fuera Del Mapa Con Chicote
programme.desc: Antonio Resines y Karlos Arguiñano acompañan a Alberto Chicote en una increíble ruta por la agreste costa guipuzcoana que recorre caminos de verde intenso, acantilados de más de 50 millones de años y playas sacadas del fin del mundo.

programme.title: Fuera Del Mapa Con Chicote
programme.desc: Chicote y Raquel Sánchez Silva conocerán los secretos de los piratas que pasaron por las costas de Almería y pasearemos por diferentes localizaciones de costa y de interior de grandes producciones cinematográficas.

programme.title: Asesinas
programme.desc: Luisa Moragón falleció en extrañas circunstancias el día que iban a darle el alta. Un cuadro clínico de lo más extraño que puso en alerta al personal del hospital y a la Policía.

programme.title: Asesinas
programme.desc: El 13 de mayo de 2016, unos pescadores de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria avisan a la Guardia Civil de un macabro hallazgo: entre las rocas flota el cadáver de un hombre.

programme.title: Asesinas

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: SoCal summer is calling, and the Local Knowledge crew is back on Ali’s home turf in San Diego, California. With reports of hot bites and fish moving in, the crew faces a classic Southern California dilemma — chase big yellowtail around the Coronado Islands or head north in search of bluefin tuna. The options are plenty, the challenges are real, and that’s exactly what keeps fishing in SoCal so exciting.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: When the yellowtail at the islands refuse to play, it’s time to switch up the game plan. Ali and Rush pivot north of San Diego in search of hard-charging bluefin tuna during a multi-day mission aboard the 43’ custom ACI Catamaran "Killer Bee". Armed with the right crew, the right gear, and a never-quit mindset, the guys roll the dice on an overnight move—hoping to wake up to redemption and put a few quality bluefin on deck.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge

Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Mother Isabel confesses to Camila but the girl knows she is still lying. Jeli, her little sister, suffers because of Fernando's irresponsibility, who impregnated her. Max announces to Marcelina and Astrid that he will soon marry Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto hires Anton, a criminal, to assassinate Rosa Blanco; Camila and Max, happy, tell Father Tiziano about their upcoming wedding. Accompanied by Luciano, they summon Rosa to a busy street, but she does not appear. Meanwhile, Sebastian and Julia, Amelia and Gregorio, in their respective homes, share their sadness.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila explains to Ezequiel and Julia the reason for her happiness: she will marry Max, and will also soon be reunited with her mother. Through Luciano, Rosa sends her the address where they are going to meet, but Elda, furious, copies the data and reveals it to Inspector Torrealba who orders a police operation to arrest her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila spots a woman matching her mother's description. Anton, the hitman, is also there and armed, he goes to them. Torrealba orders his men to run to the women, grab Camila and take the woman away.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Rosa Blanco makes a call to Fausto and disturbs Ezequiel with threats against him, Octavia and her entire family. Camila hears her mother's voice for the first time, but she tells her that she is calling her only to say goodbye, since they want to kill her. Camila receives a notebook sent by Rosa.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Only Camila should know the contents of what was written in the notebook. Her anger and rage grows and she thinks that her mother has the right to take revenge. Those involved feel fear and nervousness about the contents of the notebook. Max calls Camila and although she says she loves him very much, she does not express joy for the upcoming wedding.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: The four women who destroyed Rosa Blanco's life meet again in an empty house. Camila confronts Fausto accusing Patricia of being Leoncio's murderer. Once again a motorist warns her not to keep looking for her mother and snatches her letter.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

programme.title: Corrupt Crimes
programme.desc: True-crime series are a staple of the TV landscape. "Corrupt Crimes" analyzes recent criminal cases through a combination of expert testimony and dramatic storytelling. From crimes like doping in sports to more serious offenses like murder, the series exposes what is really going on in each case. Exposing corruption across the United States is the goal of the series. Cases featured in the half-hour episodes include an ATM heist that resulted in nearly $45 million being stolen worldwide and the former Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick.

programme.desc: La economia ha colapsado. En un universo de pobreza moral y economica, Flavia, una adolescente mimada con aspiraciones artisticas, no es aceptada en la universidad. Su vecino Martin, un hombre maduro con rutinas rigidas, es su opuesto. Entre ellos hay friccion constante.

programme.title: LOS ANOS AZULES

programme.title: LA VIDA SIN MEMORIA
programme.desc: Un ingeniero de minas, un sacerdote y un albanil graban peliculas caseras sobre sus historias personales en Zacatecas entre 1930 y 1950. Probablemente comparten algo en comun; por ejemplo, el origen de su aficion por filmar sus recuerdos.

programme.title: SIN PALABRAS

From food markets to luxury food shops, from a private dinner party to a private cooking lesson with the city's hottest chef, Sarah leaves no cocktail unmixed or pastry uneaten in her gastronomic quest.

programme.desc: Yay! Candy! A pastry kitchen can also include a confectionery, where candies are made. Here are some staples that every pastry chef learns to make.

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
programme.desc: With a glimpse into life at home, Jamie makes a beautiful meat-free mushroom cannelloni and whips up delicious garlic prawn kebabs, which helps the seafood go that little bit further.

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
programme.desc: Jamie gives roast chicken a Korean-inspired makeover with a flavor-packed kimchi glaze, beautifully dressed in sesame seeds. He then makes a deliciously simple traybake: salmon stuffed with creamy prawns, wrapped in bacon.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today we’re in and around Birmingham and Wolverhampton and first up is Adian’s Dining where chef Adian and fiance and front of house manager Eloise are showcasing their Caribbean/ Asian fusion menu. However they quickly discover that fellow foodies Kieran and Brandy from Smoking Bagels are vocal about what they do and don’t like leaving Fiona and Simon of Rodeos nervous about what’s to come.

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: In this episode Silvia shares a few new tricks and hacks that Italians have learned to embrace. From a one Pot Tuna Pasta method even Silvia thought was too good to be true, to a no-knead method of baking sensational bread and finally the easiest pasta dish Silvia has ever made.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Start the day right with Kirsten's hot chocolate cubes and a fruity chocolate babka. Next on the menu today is a luscious strawberry & cream trifle and a tasty parfait with white chocolate and peanuts.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt

In this season finale, Sarah hosts a BBQ party for her visiting family and new French friends.

programme.desc: Jamie kicks things off with his super-fast Peachy Pork Chops – sophisticated flavor in a flash; followed by peas, beans, chili, and mint, a seriously speedy versatile veg dish that turns humble garden peas into something simply stunning.

programme.desc: A GOLDEN TICKET is at stake in this round – which will fast track the winner to the Grand Final. But first, the 3 remaining contestants must fight it out, to create the most inventive dessert, that is more than meets the eye.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Sussex, business partners Will and Jack are kicking off the week with some decidedly risky fare from their restaurant MED. Head chef Will doesn't like to waste any part of the animal when it comes to his food so is including the hearts of the duck for his BBQ duck main. - Before they can even get to the main, head chef Amy from from Ami Bistro runs in to trouble with the trout tartare starter. Raw fish is just not her thing but her front of house guy, Ryan, is more than impressed by Will's luxurious beard.

programme.title: Cook Like An Italian
programme.desc: Silvia starts with the basics. How do Italian home cooks shop for pantry staples and fresh produce? A guided visit to an Italian deli leads to shopping and preparing of: a rustic Tuscan chickpea pasta, bakes 2 succulent and savoury Schiacciata breads and Silvia's mothers Apple and Mascarpone cake. programme.desc: HOPE IS HERE features inspiring and uplifting, relevant and refreshing, personal stories told by cancer survivors, their families, and the loved ones of those who lost the fight against this “emperor of all maladies” and sparked a movement that gives added meaning to their lives. Their moving stories show how the light of hope is salvaged from depths of despair.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Lung cancer diagnoses for young, non-smoking individuals are a growing trend. But that didn't intimidate the athletic and courageous lung cancer patient, 21-year-old Jill Costello. Jill's fighting spirit and her desire to help find a cure and eradicate the stigma that only smokers contracted the disease would eventually define her legacy.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Hank Baskett was given the grim diagnosis of stage 4 lung cancer almost ten years ago. At the time his thoughts were not of himself but of how he was going to tell his family. In episode 3 of Hope is Here we meet Hank and his family and learn how he was able to push forward towards health with a hopeful attitude and mission that his cancer journey would be, in his words, a joyful one.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Gina Hollenbeck is positive about life. Every day she lives with an optimistic desire to overcome and thrive despite a stage 4 lung cancer diagnosis. As a young mother of two boys, she forges ahead towards a vibrant and meaningful journey with a mission to help find a cure for not only herself but for others who suffer from this deadly disease.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Emily Bennett Taylor and her husband Miles were newlyweds with a bright future planned. Just as they were house hunting and talking about raising a family Emily received the news that she had stage 4 lung cancer. She and her husband recall their cancer journey and recount their determination to live life to its fullest while fighting for the chance to have children despite a grave cancer diagnosis.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Life can be full of hope and dreams. Lisa Briggs was enjoying a successful business, and a close-knit family while celebrating the arrival of her second child. Yet within months of giving birth Lisa was told the devastating news; she had stage 4 lung cancer. For an athletic, young woman who never smoked, the diagnosis seemed unreal. After the shock wore off, Lisa went into full action ahead as her will to live proved stronger than her devastating cancer.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Rush - Time Machine: Live in Cleveland
programme.desc: Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures,' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centerpiece of the concerts.

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix - Electric Church: Atlanta Pop Festival
programme.desc: Electric Church presents Jimi Hendrix in full flight at the 1970 Atlanta Pop Festival before the largest U.S. audience of his career.

programme.title: Soundgarden - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Foo Fighters - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Blondie -- Live in London 2014
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, giving all fans an experience; Blondie performs their hits including "Heart of Glass," "Euphoria," "Mile High" and many more.

programme.title: Rodrigo y Gabriela - Live @ Garorock Festival 2014
programme.desc: The Mexican duet takes the stage at Garorock Festival, in July 2014.

programme.title: Michael Bolton - Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience.

programme.title: Seal - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Seal's one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. He's delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career.

programme.title: Adele - iTunes Festival: Live in London
Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out 3-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in February 2008 when Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969.

programme.title: Toto - Falling In Between
programme.desc: This concert was recorded at Le Zenith in Paris in March 2007 in front of a wildly enthusiastic sell-out crowd. It captures Toto rocking at their hardest and most powerful and giving a new life to all their best loved tracks.

programme.title: Pixies Electric: Club Date live in Boston
programme.desc: Legendary alternative rock band The Pixies perform their greatest hits including 'Alison', 'Bone Machine', 'Bad Punk' and classic 'Where is My Mind' in an intimate setting in Boston.

programme.title: Blondie -- Live in London 2014
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, giving all fans an experience; Blondie performs their hits including "Heart of Glass," "Euphoria," "Mile High" and many more.

programme.title: ZZ Top - Live at Montreux
programme.desc: ZZ Top has made a number of visits to Montreux and this concert from 2013 is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. programme.title: Supertramp: Breakfast In America: Live in Paris

programme.title: John Denver - Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan is a 1981 concert from John Denver's 7-show tour of Japan and features a wonderful selection of hits from his career, including: Annie's Song, Calypso, Sunshine On My Shoulders & Thank God I'm A Country Boy.

programme.title: Adele - iTunes Festival: Live in London

programme.title: The Lumineers - Live At Musilac 2017
programme.desc: The Lumineers bring energetic American folk-rock to the picturesque Musilac Festival. You won't be able to resist clapping along and stomping your feet to the band's raw sound and enchanting music.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Nice Jazz Festival 2012
programme.desc: Watch the famous jazz singer, Gregory Porter, perform at Nice Jazz Festival 2012.

programme.title: Peter Gabriel - Secret World: Live

programme.title: The Black Keys - Live at Main Square Festival

programme.title: Bruce Springsteen: Live in Hyde Park

programme.title: Jim Morrison - Rock Poet
programme.desc: Jim Morrison was a wonderful by product of 1950's era of a new breed of artists: self-titled intellectuals and modern-day philosophers, gathering in coffee houses in New York, San Francisco and Paris reading Beat Poetry. programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: Kurt Cobain - All Apologies
programme.desc: All Apologies is a highly emotional tribute and inquisitive journey into both the man, his true persona, and his music. Daringly, it charts the downward spiral and isolation that brought down Kurt Cobain. Featuring musical selections from Cobain's list of top favorites as well as rare footage and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed
programme.desc: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed delivers a humorous but reverent look at why we love the guitar. Among the 24 distinguished people in the film: Execs from 5 major manufactures, 4 well known internet instructors and retail guitar store owners in the USA and the UK...plus distinguished professors and even the former Deputy Director of the FBI. If you play guitar, you will want to see this movie.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: The Home of Heavy
programme.desc: Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

programme.title: From The Scene For The Scene
programme.desc: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

programme.title: Where Heavy Music Lives
programme.desc: Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Right Up Your Alley
programme.desc: As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

programme.title: Metal Detector
programme.desc: Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live in London - 30th Anniversary Concert
Piano Duets -- Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o
programme.desc: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.

programme.title: Mahler: Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the LSO perform Mark-Anthony Turnage's "Remembering."

programme.title: Mozart, Violin Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: With Anne-Sophie Mutter and the Camerata Salzburg.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: A Tango Night: Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: The Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colón under Daniel Barenboim performs live at an Argentinean music festival.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Gershwin's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programme.title: Mozart -- String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: From the Rammenau castle, the Gewandhaus-Quartet performs Mozart's String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465, a piece dubbed "Dissonance" because of its unusual introduction including dissonant notes preceding a brilliant allegro.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. Recorded at La Cité de la musique in Paris in 2016.

programme.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Mineria.

programme.title: Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 5-8); recorded at St. Luke's, London.

programme.title: Beethoven: String Quartets No. 6 and 15
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all the great composer's sixteen string quartets.

programme.title: A Tango Night: Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: The Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colón under Daniel Barenboim performs live at an Argentinean music festival.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
Mozart, Violin Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: With Anne-Sophie Mutter and the Camerata Salzburg.

programme.title: Liszt's Concerto No. 1 & Mahler's Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Fifth Symphony; Lukáš Vondráček is the soloist in Liszt's First Piano Concerto.

programme.title: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: In this August 2020 concert at the Lucerne Festival, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15 with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra; Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36.

programme.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
programme.desc: Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as "The Lord of the Rings," "Game of Thrones," "The Chronicles of Narnia" and "Harry Potter." Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna from Vienna's Café Sperl; the ensemble consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Mozart -- String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: From the Rammenau castle, the Gewandhaus-Quartet performs Mozart's String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465, a piece dubbed "Dissonance" because of its unusual introduction including dissonant notes preceding a brilliant allegro.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler's "Symphony No. 2" in C minor, "Resurrection."

programme.title: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, "Winter Daydreams," recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022.

programme.title: Mahler - The Youth Wunderhorn
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn (Magic Horn) songs represent an important aspect of Mahler's engagement with the romantic tradition, even as they pave the way for his more famous symphonic works.

programme.title: Beethoven -- Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra and Chorus in a recorded performance of Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 at Barbican Hall in London.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Faure's Requiem
programme.desc: Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.

programme.desc: Los 5 jóvenes viajeros te llevarán en un salvaje viaje en autobús cebra para experimentar la versión moderna del arca de noé.
